caption: Our Simple Contact Form template on a new WordPress page, filled in with a made up visitor and a unique test code before we submitted it.
The notification email WPForms Lite sent to the site admin with every field of our test entry. In Lite this email is the only copy.
The Entries screen in Lite: Form entries are not stored in WPForms Lite. The list behind the notice is sample data from WPForms.
Standard fields such as Dropdown were free; clicking Phone under Fancy Fields opened an upgrade notice.
Stripe, PayPal Commerce and Square can be connected in Lite; the Stripe panel notes no extra WPForms transaction fees on Pro.
Pricing on 22 Nov 2026 in the Black Friday sale: Basic at $49.50 for the first year for one site, normally $99.
